{
  "proposals": [
    {
      "rationale": "Edit C0011 to classify it as a governing parent condition for the conditional list in 8 FAM 403.1-4(d), linking it explicitly via qualifies to child rules C0004, C0005, C0007, C0008, and C0009.",
      "operation": "edit",
      "target": "C0011",
      "qualifies": ["C0004", "C0005", "C0007", "C0008", "C0009"],
      "quote": "Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:",
      "fields": {
        "concepts": [
          {
            "label": "Identity Evidence Requirement Condition",
            "definition": "Parent condition establishing that evidence of identity might be required under Department guidance to determine the name that best identifies the applicant.",
            "quote": "evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant",
            "role": "rkaf:assignmentPrimary"
          }
        ],
        "claimants": [],
        "typed_values": [],
        "effective_periods": [],
        "kind": "condition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity."
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), given that the applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity."
        ],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_text": "",
        "actor_quote": "",
        "actor": "",
        "action_quote": "be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant",
        "action": "be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant",
        "object_quote": "evidence of identity",
        "object": "evidence of identity",
        "jurisdiction_quote": "",
        "jurisdiction": "",
        "relation": "scope",
        "references": [
          "22 CFR 51.23(c)"
        ],
        "summary": "Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant, governing the identity documentation requirements in 8 FAM 403.1-4(d)."
      }
    },
    {
      "rationale": "Add a companion exception for the emergency travel clause in 8 FAM 403.1-4(d)(1), which relaxes the requirement in C0004 to suspend the DS-11 application when there is insufficient time before urgent or emergency travel.",
      "operation": "add",
      "target": "",
      "qualifies": ["C0004"],
      "quote": "If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;",
      "fields": {
        "concepts": [
          {
            "label": "Urgent Travel Exception to Application Suspension",
            "definition": "Exception to the requirement to suspend a passport application to request acceptable ID when there is insufficient time prior to urgent or emergency travel.",
            "quote": "If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name",
            "role": "rkaf:assignmentPrimary"
          }
        ],
        "claimants": [],
        "typed_values": [],
        "effective_periods": [],
        "kind": "exception",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When an applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 without updating her/his ID, and there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity. Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_text": "If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel",
        "actor_quote": "",
        "actor": "",
        "action_quote": "suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name",
        "action": "suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name",
        "object_quote": "the application",
        "object": "the application",
        "jurisdiction_quote": "",
        "jurisdiction": "",
        "relation": "exception",
        "references": [
          "DS-11"
        ],
        "summary": "Excepts passport personnel from the mandatory requirement to suspend an application to request acceptable ID when there is insufficient time to request submission of acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel."
      }
    },
    {
      "rationale": "Add a companion exception for the unless-clause in 8 FAM 403.1-4(c), which relaxes the prohibition in C0003 against continuing to use a previous name after a material name change.",
      "operation": "add",
      "target": "",
      "qualifies": ["C0003"],
      "quote": "unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name",
      "fields": {
        "concepts": [
          {
            "label": "Permitted Continuation of Previous Name",
            "definition": "Exception permitting an applicant to continue using a previous name after a material name change if documentation specifically allows it.",
            "quote": "unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name",
            "role": "rkaf:assignmentPrimary"
          }
        ],
        "claimants": [],
        "typed_values": [],
        "effective_periods": [],
        "kind": "exception",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "after a material name change"
        ],
        "scope_text": "After a material name change.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_text": "unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name",
        "actor_quote": "the applicant",
        "actor": "The applicant",
        "action_quote": "continue using that name",
        "action": "continue using that name",
        "object_quote": "that name",
        "object": "a previous name",
        "jurisdiction_quote": "",
        "jurisdiction": "",
        "relation": "exception",
        "references": [
          "8 FAM 403.1-6"
        ],
        "summary": "Excepts the applicant from the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name after a material name change if the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name."
      }
    }
  ],
  "observations": [
    {
      "quote": "see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)",
      "rationale": "The exception for married names points to remote section 8 FAM 403.1-4(C) and is already represented within the context quotes, references, and summary of claim C0001.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names",
      "rationale": "The cross-reference to external guidance regarding 'known as' names in 8 FAM 403.1-6 is already represented in the references and context quotes of claim C0003.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    }
  ]
}
